mapper.select: SELECT id, term_text, term_normalized, prefix_text, term_type, source_id, source_biz_type, hot_score, quality_score, search_count, click_count, result_count, status FROM search_suggest_term WHERE prefix_text = #{prefixText} AND term_type = #{termType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY hot_score DESC, quality_score DESC, updated_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
